ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity off-white/light-grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white zones occupy the central regions of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation forms a continuous thick band along the trailing edge, distal tips, and leading edge margins, with a dense vertical cluster at the median notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 55-degree internal angle and significant depth relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations characterized by jagged peaks and varying valley depths along the entire trailing edge boundary, including distinct notches on the lateral margins.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in narrow, pointed distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Numerous high-contrast dark linear marks (rake marks) of varying lengths and orientations (primarily vertical and diagonal) across the central high-intensity regions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent linear rake marks across the ventral surface and significant irregular erosion/scalloping of the trailing edge topography.
other_distinctive_markers: Deeply recessed notch and asymmetrical dark pigmentation streaks extending from the trailing edge into the interior of the left lobe.
